about_the_game:
Kotoba Dash is a fast-paced Japanese vocabulary game that blends arcade-style action with language learning. This demo lets you try Classic Mode on Easy difficulty, featuring beginner-friendly N5 vocabulary. It’s best suited for new learners and those looking to review the basics in a fun, replayable format.

Learn Through Play 

Every round tests your knowledge of Japanese words as you dash to collect the correct scroll. The faster you grab scrolls, the higher your score climbs. But choose wrong, and you’ll lose a life. Accuracy and speed work together to drive your score higher, helping you track your personal best and see your progress over time.

What's in the Demo

  • Classic Mode (Easy) – Dash to collect the correct scrolls while avoiding mistakes.

  • N5 Vocabulary Only – Practice essential beginner words.

  • Full Vocabulary List – Browse and study outside of gameplay.

  • Review Screens – Learn from your mistakes after each run.

  • Score Chasing – Test your accuracy and speed to set a new personal best.

  • Replayable Runs – Each attempt feels fresh, making review fun instead of repetitive.

Who It’s For

This demo is designed for beginner and intermediate learners of Japanese who want a quick, engaging way to reinforce vocabulary. It’s also great for casual players who enjoy fast-paced arcade challenges with an educational twist.

How many scrolls can you collect before mistakes cut your run short?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
